value.message: Town of Oakville runs Preschool A Learn to Swim, Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for 3-5 year olds (no parent in water) - their site says. Fall registration opens Tues Aug 11 at 7am for residents; prices are set in the current Recreation Guide, which I'll keep watching for and text you when posted.
